biotools.summary: GeoTox is an open-source R software package for characterizing the risk of perturbing molecular targets involved in adverse human health outcomes based on exposure to spatially-referenced stressor mixtures. It facilitates source-to-outcome continuum modeling for individual and population-level risk assessment.
